sql.Unassigned tickets: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM "Ticket" WHERE status IN ('NEW','OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','WAITING_FOR_REQUESTER','REOPENED') AND "assigneeId" IS NULL
sql.Assigned to me: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM "Ticket" WHERE status IN ('NEW','OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','WAITING_FOR_REQUESTER','REOPENED') AND "assigneeId" = (SELECT id FROM "User" WHERE email = 'thanawat.it@toktickit.dev')
sql.Urgent and active: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM "Ticket" WHERE status IN ('NEW','OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','WAITING_FOR_REQUESTER','REOPENED') AND "itPriority" = 'URGENT'
sql.Requester says resolved: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM "Ticket" WHERE status IN ('NEW','OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','WAITING_FOR_REQUESTER','REOPENED') AND "requesterResolvedFlaggedAt" IS NOT NULL
sql.My follow-ups: SELECT count(DISTINCT t.id)::int AS n FROM "Ticket" t JOIN "ActionTaken" a ON a."ticketId" = t.id WHERE t.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND a."performedById" = (SELECT id FROM "User" WHERE email = 'thanawat.it@toktickit.dev') AND a."followUpRequired" AND a."followUpCompletedAt" IS NULL AND a."voidedAt" IS NULL
sql.New today: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM "Ticket" WHERE "createdAt" >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')
